groups.name: http
groups.description: HTTP request tooling powered by lua-curl with curl-style argument parsing.

tools.name: vulcan-curl-get
tools.description: Execute one simple GET request with url, params, headers, and timeout only. Use the base vulcan-curl tool for complex curl flags or advanced TLS, proxy, upload, and retry needs.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target request URL.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Optional query params object. Object values are URL-encoded and appended automatically.

parameters.name: params_list
parameters.description: Optional raw query fragment array such as ["q=hello", "page=1"].

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional request headers as a simple object map.

parameters.name: header_lines
parameters.description: Optional raw header string array such as ["Accept: application/json"].

parameters.name: bearer
parameters.description: Optional bearer token shortcut. Adds Authorization: Bearer <token> unless Authorization is already provided in headers.

parameters.name: basic
parameters.description: Optional basic auth shortcut object with username and password.

parameters.name: basic_text
parameters.description: Optional basic auth shortcut string in the form user:pass.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Optional request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

parameters.name: follow_location
parameters.description: Optional redirect-follow flag for common 30x cases.

parameters.name: download_to
parameters.description: Optional local file path used to save the response body.

parameters.name: save_headers_to
parameters.description: Optional local file path used to save response headers.

tools.prompt: Use this tool for the common AI case of making a simple GET request with URL params and headers. Keep it simple. If you need advanced curl flags, proxy tuning, certificate files, upload options, retries, or non-GET methods, switch to the base vulcan-curl tool.

tools.name: vulcan-curl-post
tools.description: Execute one simple POST request with url, headers, and one body mode: json, form, or raw body. Use the base vulcan-curl tool for complex curl flags or advanced TLS, proxy, upload, and retry needs.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Target request URL.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional request headers as a simple object map.

parameters.name: header_lines
parameters.description: Optional raw header string array such as ["Accept: application/json"].

parameters.name: bearer
parameters.description: Optional bearer token shortcut. Adds Authorization: Bearer <token> unless Authorization is already provided in headers.

parameters.name: basic
parameters.description: Optional basic auth shortcut object with username and password.

parameters.name: basic_text
parameters.description: Optional basic auth shortcut string in the form user:pass.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: Optional JSON payload object. Cannot be combined with form or body.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: Optional simple form payload as an object map. Can be combined with files, but cannot be combined with json or body.

parameters.name: form_lines
parameters.description: Optional curl-style form string array such as ["name=alice"]. Can be combined with files.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Optional multipart file payload as an object of field->local file path. Can be combined with form, but cannot be combined with json or body.

parameters.name: file_lines
parameters.description: Optional curl-style multipart file string array such as ["upload=@local.txt"]. Can be combined with form.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional raw request body string. Cannot be combined with json, form, or files.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Optional query params object appended to the URL.

parameters.name: params_list
parameters.description: Optional raw query fragment array such as ["page=1", "q=hello"].

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Optional request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 60000.

parameters.name: follow_location
parameters.description: Optional redirect-follow flag for common 30x cases.

parameters.name: download_to
parameters.description: Optional local file path used to save the response body.

parameters.name: save_headers_to
parameters.description: Optional local file path used to save response headers.

tools.prompt: Use this tool for the common AI case of making a simple POST request. Choose one payload family: json, raw body, or multipart form/files. Simple form fields and files may be combined for common multipart uploads. If you need advanced curl flags, certificate tuning, proxy settings, retries, or non-simple request semantics, switch to the base vulcan-curl tool.

tools.name: vulcan-curl
tools.description: Execute one HTTP request through lua-curl using Linux curl-style argv semantics without depending on platform-specific shell syntax.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Curl-style argv list excluding the leading executable. Example: ["-X", "POST", "https://example.com", "-H", "Authorization: Bearer ..."]

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.description: Optional working directory used to resolve relative file paths for -o, -F @file, <file, --cacert, --cert, --key and related inputs.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Optional default timeout in milliseconds when curl args do not provide --max-time. Defaults to 60000.

tools.prompt: Use this tool when you want Linux curl-style HTTP behavior but do not want to deal with different shell escaping rules across Windows, Linux, PowerShell, pwsh, or sh. Pass curl argv as a structured array without the leading curl executable. The tool is powered by lua-curl, not the system curl binary, and returns one Markdown string.
